name: SikaSeal Appliance Sealant
paste:
SIKASEAL® APPLIANCE SEALANT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaSeal® Appliance Sealant, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sikaseal_appliancesealant.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaSeal® Appliance Sealant where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaSeal® Appliance Silicone Sealant is a premium one-component room temperature vulcanising (RTV) silicone rubber designed for flexible gasketing and sealing applications. SikaSeal® Appliance Silicone Sealant forms a tough but flexible seal of all shapes and sizes and fills any surface voids. The cured product can withstand vibration, weathering, temperature extremes, water oil and grease without hardening, shrinking or cracking.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fridge and freezer sealing
    - Pizza oven sealing
    - Oven sealing
    - Aluminium
    - Glass
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaSeal® Appliance Sealant
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Premium one-component room temperature vulcanising silicone sealant
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - High temperature resitance (-50°c to 250°c)
    - Excellent adhesion
    - Heat proof
    - Gap filling properties
    - Vibration resistant
    - Highly versatile
    - Excellent resistance to aging, shrinkage, cracking and disclouration.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: 1-C Silicone (acetoxy)
    - Colour: Black
    - Density: ~0.98 Kg/l (uncured)
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore A hardness: ~22
    - Secant tensile modulus: ~1.05 MPa
    - Tensile strain at break: ~600%
    - Tensile adhesion strength: ~1.0 N/mm²
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 300ml Cartridge, 12 cartridges per box
    - Shelf life: 18 months from date of production if in undamaged and unopened original sealed containers and stored according to the storage conditions.
    - Storage conditions: Must be stored in dry conditions and protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +10ºC and +25ºC.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Ensure all surfaces are clean, dry and free from dust, grease and loose material. Remove all old gasket material from surfaces before cleaning with a residue-free solvent and allowing to completely dry.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Curing time: ~24 hours
    - Skinning time: ~10 minutes
    - Tack free time: ~20 minutes
4.3 Application method / tools. Cut the nozzle at a 45° angle to the desired bead size (3 mm is suitable for most applications) then apply a continuous and even bead along the joint.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Uncured, excess SikaSeal® Appliance may be removed with Sika® Remover-208 or another suitable solvent. Once cured, the excess sealant can be trimmed away from the edges with a knife.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations - Limitations.
    - SikaSeal® Appliance is not recommended for use in applications where it will be permanently exposed to temperatures exceeding 250°C.
    - Not suitable for exposure to or contact with fuels.
    - Must be protected from rain for atleast 2 hours after application.
    - The above information is offered for general guidance only.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5°c to +45°c
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - SikaSeal® Appliance is not recommended for use in applications where it will be permanently exposed to temperatures exceeding 250°C.
    - Must be protected from rain for atleast 2 hours after application.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaSeal® Appliance Sealant, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sikaseal_appliancesealant.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaSeal Appliance Sealant, version 23/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/MSDS%20SikaSeal%20Appliance%20Sealant%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions.
    - Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product
    - Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
